moments.title: Love Island UK Final
moments.blurb: The 13th season of Love Island UK concludes with its live final on Monday night, with Maya Jama hosting as the winning couple is crowned and takes home the £50,000 prize.

angles.name: Who will win?
angles.copy: After weeks of drama, romance, and bombshells, who do you want to see crowned Love Island champions tomorrow night? The final is LIVE! #LoveIslandUK

angles.name: Monday night plans
angles.copy: Got your snacks ready? The Love Island UK final is tomorrow night at 9pm on ITV2 and ITVX. What's been your favourite moment this series?

moments.title: Commonwealth Games Closing Ceremony
moments.blurb: The Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games conclude on Sunday, August 2nd, with a spectacular closing ceremony at the OVO Hydro, headlined by Scottish rock band Simple Minds.

angles.name: Glasgow farewell
angles.copy: Glasgow gets ready to say farewell! The Commonwealth Games wrap up this Sunday with Simple Minds headlining the closing ceremony at the OVO Hydro. What's been your favourite moment of #Glasgow2026?

angles.name: Sporting highs
angles.copy: It's been an incredible week of sport in Glasgow! The Commonwealth Games close this Sunday, August 2nd. Who's delivered your top sporting highlight?

moments.title: The Hundred Cricket Tournament
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament is in full swing across the UK, with daily men's and women's matches featuring teams like Welsh Fire and MI London, running until mid-August.

angles.name: Welsh Fire action
angles.copy: Welsh Fire are burning bright in The Hundred! Catch the latest action from Cardiff and follow the team as the tournament heats up.

angles.name: Cricket fever
angles.copy: Bowled over by The Hundred? Cricket's fast-paced tournament is delivering daily action across the UK. Who are you backing for the title?

moments.title: Major UK Summer Festivals Kick Off
moments.blurb: Several major UK music and wellbeing festivals, including Good Vibrations Society, Belladrum Tartan Heart, Camp Bestival Dorset, Kendal Calling, and Y Not Festival, begin this week, offering diverse lineups and experiences.

angles.name: Festival season peak
angles.copy: The summer festival season hits full swing this week! From Belladrum in Scotland to Camp Bestival in Dorset, where will you be pitching up?

angles.name: Good Vibrations
angles.copy: Good Vibrations Society Festival kicks off in East Sussex this Friday, July 31st, featuring Ms Dynamite, Gentleman's Dub Club, and Orbital (DJ set). Who are you excited to see?

moments.title: Grace Jones at Crystal Palace Bowl
moments.blurb: The iconic Grace Jones headlines the Palace Bowl Presents series at Crystal Palace Bowl in London on Friday, July 31st, with special guests Sophie Ellis-Bextor and Soul II Soul.

angles.name: Legendary London night
angles.copy: London! Get ready for a legendary night as Grace Jones takes over Crystal Palace Bowl this Friday, July 31st, with Sophie Ellis-Bextor and Soul II Soul. What a line-up!

angles.name: Iconic performer
angles.copy: Grace Jones, Sophie Ellis-Bextor, Soul II Soul... Crystal Palace Bowl on Friday is going to be HUGE. Expect iconic sounds and unforgettable vibes.

moments.title: Mick Jagger's 83rd Birthday
moments.blurb: The legendary frontman of The Rolling Stones, Mick Jagger, celebrates his 83rd birthday today, July 26th. He was born in 1943.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll icon
angles.copy: Still got the moves like Jagger! The iconic Rolling Stones frontman Mick Jagger turns 83 today. What's your favourite Stones track? #MickJagger

angles.name: Birthday playlist
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the one and only Mick Jagger! We'll be spinning some classic Stones all day long. #Legend

moments.title: Kate Bush's 68th Birthday
moments.blurb: The influential and enigmatic singer-songwriter Kate Bush celebrates her 68th birthday on Thursday, July 30th. She was born in 1958.

angles.name: Running Up That Hill
angles.copy: Wuthering Heights to Running Up That Hill, Kate Bush turns 68 on Thursday! What's your go-to track from the truly unique artist? #KateBush

angles.name: Musical genius
angles.copy: Ahead of her 68th birthday on Thursday, we're celebrating the musical genius of Kate Bush. Her impact on music is undeniable.

moments.title: Don Henley's 79th Birthday
moments.blurb: Don Henley, co-founder, singer, and drummer for the Eagles, turns 79 on Friday, July 31st. He was born in 1947.

angles.name: Eagles legend
angles.copy: Peaceful Easy Feeling! Happy 79th birthday this Friday to Eagles legend Don Henley. What's your favourite song he sang lead on? #DonHenley

angles.name: Classic rock voice
angles.copy: From 'Hotel California' to his solo hits, Don Henley's voice is unmistakable. Celebrate his 79th birthday this Friday with us! #ClassicRock

moments.title: James Hetfield's 63rd Birthday
moments.blurb: James Hetfield, the iconic co-founder, lead vocalist, and rhythm guitarist of Metallica, celebrates his 63rd birthday on Monday, August 3rd. He was born in 1963.

angles.name: Master of Puppets
angles.copy: Yeah-ah! Raise your horns for James Hetfield, who turns 63 this Monday! What's your ultimate Metallica anthem? #JamesHetfield

angles.name: Thrash Metal King
angles.copy: From 'Enter Sandman' to 'One', James Hetfield's roar defines metal. Wishing him a huge 63rd birthday this Monday! #MetalLegend

moments.title: UK Weather: Brief Hot Spell
moments.blurb: The UK is set for a mixed weather pattern, with central and eastern England potentially seeing very warm to hot temperatures peaking in the mid-30s Celsius on Wednesday, July 29th, before cooler conditions return.

angles.name: Heatwave alert
angles.copy: Get ready for a mini-heatwave! Central and Eastern England could hit mid-30s on Wednesday before things cool down. Stay hydrated!
